# Myanmar (MMR) — notes

- Source: CSO "Myanmar Data CD-ROM" / Statistical Yearbook, Justice and Security chapter (https://www.csostat.gov.mm/Content/PublicationAndRelease/<year>/4.htm), Table 4.02 "Selected Crimes" by the 14 states/regions plus Nay Pyi Taw, row "Murder". Editions 2020-2024 downloaded (2018 and 2019 editions' Excel files return 404). Years covered: 2005, 2010, 2015-2023. National totals (4.01) and national rates per 100,000 (4.04) from the 2024 edition added as level "country".
- Layout faults in the Excel files: 2024 edition page 1 (Kachin, Kayah, Kayin) has two columns headed "2023". The last column was used because the 15 areas then add up exactly to the national 1,575 (and 2022 to 2,225). The extra column held Kachin 104, Kayah 7, Kayin 44 — not used. The 2023 edition page 1 has a stray column headed 2021 with unrelated numbers (e.g. 6567) — not used; all 2021 values come from the 2024 edition.
- "-" (Nay Pyi Taw 2005-2015, before it was separated) left blank with note.
- Other selected crimes in the same table (dacoity, robbery, rape, theft, etc.) were not extracted — murder only. Table 4.09 gives prisoners by state/region; 4.15 road casualties by state/region.
- 2021-2023 figures cover the period after the February 2021 military takeover; the publisher is the military-controlled administration. Conflict killings are probably not fully counted as "murder".
- No licence statement on the CSO site pages opened.
